HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o.
   B. Apply the teaching of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Aspects of integrity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Aspects of integrity has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Aspects of integrity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Aspects of integrity.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calendar.
   B. Use Indian Traditional Calendar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Indian Traditional Calendar has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calendar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues for righteousness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Virtues for righteousness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Virtues for righteousness has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues for righteousness.
   D. Use Virtues for righteousness to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s? (1 mark)
   A. Use Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s.
   D. Say Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Panch- mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Say Panch- mahabhoot has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Panch- mahabhoot with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Panch- mahabhoot to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Panch- mahabhoot.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8..
   D. Say Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Dainik Prarthana? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Dainik Prarthana with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dainik Prarthana.
   C. Say Dainik Prarthana has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Dainik Prarthana to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. .
   B. Say Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
